outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: under executor.writerModel the triage first runs review_findings_step. sort_findings blames each open finding's cited lines (cited_ranges + git blame --porcelain at HEAD, blame_commits) against every commit a phase task records or carried (task_commits, reviewCommits): no task-written line -> note 'cites no line of the phase diff' (clause 5); low -> note; the rest are candidates for one validation session (validation_dispatch/validation_said, new steps dispatch-validation / wait-validation in STEPS and SIGNAL_VERBS, runner --role reviewer on the reviewer-session model, prompt VALIDATE_HEAD + each finding + VALIDATE_RULE). validation_step requires a result, a stream with a tool call (one redispatch, then a stop) and a return answering every asked id confirmed|withdrawn with kind correctness|requirement|other (read_verdicts); anything less stops and validates nothing. Verdicts are held in state findingVerdicts with the HEAD they were given at and read only while HEAD is that commit (held_verdict). Withdrawn or confirmed-as-other -> note (clause 1). A confirmed correctness/requirement finding re-opens (audit-task.py reopen, --reason on stdin) the task whose commit wrote most of its cited lines (hand_back), after keeping its last writer session id, stream and tree (last_writer_session) in state reviewFixes; the drive loop continues (HANDED_BACK sentinel from sign_off) to start it, and dispatch() routes its writer through review_fix_dispatch: --resume on that session when warm_session finds its saved stream written under CACHE_LIFE_SECONDS (3600) ago in the same tree, prompt = REVIEW_FIX_HEAD + the confirmed findings; otherwise a fresh session whose prompt is the task's own writer brief + the findings (clause 2), each noted on the task. settle_review_fixes runs resolve-finding --fix-task once the task closes at a new commit; a hand-back that closes at no new commit is not re-opened again (stop). No fix task is ever added on this path: the triage's offered list now excludes every sorted finding (clause 4). With review.maxRounds filed reviews and a confirmed finding open, cap_stop stops the phase (exit 1), lists the open findings, and notes them once per HEAD on the owning task (clause 3). Notes: triage shows them as 'a note, not a block' lines (finding_lines), leaves them out of its findings (triage, refresh_triage), carries notedHead, and pending_still_applies drops a triage holding notes once HEAD moved (the P131.17-style basis check); run_signoff records each note --accept-open <id>='a note, not a block - <why>'. writer_said prints 'for the phase review's findings' for a round-0 resume. Module docstring paragraph added; new section markers. audit-lookup.py: the phase brief gains a 'Reading the work' section (OPEN_CODE_LINE: open each changed function, cite file:line, and says nothing checks the opening) and one 'gate results, per step, of run <id>:' line per task (_gate_results_line: each step's exit, outcome, mute; or why none). phase-signoff.md: one paragraph naming the writer-session route. Tests: test_drive_phase.py pv1-pv6 in two new stages pv-block/pv4-block (STAGES), _tdd_writer_repo takes per_task/review, the signal corpus gains dispatch-validation and wait-validation; test_audit_lookup.py bf60. outcome.descriptive: Under a writer session a phase-review finding blocks only once a validation session confirms it as a correctness or requirement finding; that finding goes back to the writer session of the task that wrote the lines (resumed while warm, else fresh), every other finding is a note on the phase, no fix task is added, and the round cap stops the phase.

testsAdded: pv1: the phase review's med+ findings citing task-written lines go to a validation reviewer session; the one citing no phase-diff line and the low one are not sent
pv2: a confirmed finding resumes the owning task's own writer session (last active under an hour), prompt carries only that finding, no fix task

pv3: withdrawn, low and outside-diff findings never block; the phase signs off with each recorded accepted-open with a note reason; the confirmed one fixed by the task's own new commit; still no fix task
pv4: a confirmed finding whose writer stream was last written two hours ago starts a fresh writer session with the task text and the finding
pv5: after review.maxRounds an open confirmed finding stops the phase (exit 1) with a note on the owning task, and a later next stops the same way with no session
pv6: a triage showing notes holds only while HEAD is the commit they were sorted at; one without notes is held to no HEAD
bf60: the phase brief carries each task's diff, one per-step gate results line per task, and the open-each-changed-function instruction once before the first task
